name: Tiki
description: Tiki Open API for sellers on the Vietnamese marketplace: orders, stock and dropship confirmation, shipping labels and seller delivery results, products with price and stock per warehouse, seller warehouses and inventories, categories, brands and product requests. In-house app ID and secret.
instructions:
## Tiki
This connector works with the **Tiki Open API** (`https://api.tiki.vn/integration`), for sellers on Tiki, the Vietnamese marketplace: orders with stock confirmation, dropship confirmation, labels and seller delivery results, products with price and stock per warehouse, seller warehouses and inventories, categories, brands and product requests.

**Setup (about 10 minutes)**
1. Log in to the Tiki Open Platform console at `https://open.tiki.vn` with your Tiki account and open **Application, Create** (`https://open.tiki.vn/web/console/apps/create`).
2. Fill in the name, summary, description, homepage and icon. As **Token endpoint auth method** choose **basic header** (it cannot be changed later), and as application type **In-house**.
3. Enter your store id (the number without the S prefix) and store name, and submit. Copy the **App ID** into `TIKI_CLIENT_ID` and the **App Secret** into `TIKI_CLIENT_SECRET`.
4. Approve the connection in Tiki Seller Center: **Seller info, Detail, Store Setting and Contact Info, Manage, Integrated Applications**. Until then every call answers 401.

The connector gets a token at `https://api.tiki.vn/sc/oauth2/token` (client credentials, HTTP Basic) and renews it when it expires. An in-house app has every permission of the store, so there are no scopes to pick. Tiki has only a production environment.

**Where to start**: `tiki_list_orders` with item_confirmation_status waiting (orders to confirm) and status `nin|processing,waiting_payment`, then `tiki_get_order`.

**Confirming orders**: an order fulfilled from your stock (tiki_delivery, seller_delivery, cross_border) is confirmed with `tiki_confirm_available`, listing the items you can supply and a seller inventory from `tiki_list_seller_inventories` (pass the order's Tiki warehouse code). Items left out are cancelled. A dropship order is confirmed with `tiki_confirm_dropship`; `tiki_cancel_dropship` refuses one and is installed switched off. `tiki_get_shipping_label` returns the label link for the order's delivery model. Orders you deliver yourself get their result with `tiki_update_seller_delivery`. There is no return or cancellation API: returns show as `is_rma` orders and the returned status.

**Products and stock**: `tiki_list_products` (include inventory for stock per warehouse), `tiki_get_product`, `tiki_find_product_by_sku` (your original_sku), `tiki_update_product` (price in VND and stock per seller warehouse from `tiki_list_seller_warehouses`; not for instock products stored at Tiki). `tiki_set_product_active` is switched off, because 0 takes the product off sale. `tiki_list_product_requests` and `tiki_get_tracking` follow product requests; `tiki_list_categories`, `tiki_get_category_attributes`, `tiki_list_brands` and `tiki_list_tiki_warehouses` give the reference data. `tiki_get_seller` shows the store and its operation models. Creating products is not included.

**Formats**: dates are `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` in Vietnam time (UTC+7); prices are VND. Set filters on orders are written `in|a,b` or `nin|a,b`. Lists take `page` from 1 and `limit`; the answer has `paging` (total, current_page, last_page). Errors are `errors` (a list of messages) with 400, 401 (token missing, expired or the app not connected to the store), 403, 422 or 429.

**Rate limit**: 200 requests per second per seller; a 429 should be retried later, other 4xx answers not.

TIKI_CLIENT_ID.label: App ID
TIKI_CLIENT_ID.help: Tiki Open Platform console, Application: the App ID of your in-house application.
TIKI_CLIENT_ID.patternMessage: Paste the App ID only, e.g. 7590139168389961.

TIKI_CLIENT_SECRET.label: App secret
TIKI_CLIENT_SECRET.help: Shown with the App ID when the in-house application is created.
TIKI_CLIENT_SECRET.patternMessage: Paste the App secret without spaces.

400.hint: Tiki did not issue a token. Check the App ID and secret, and that the application was created with the basic header token auth method.

verifyHints.401: Tiki refused the token: the in-house app is not yet connected to your store. Approve it in Seller Center, Seller info, Store Setting and Contact Info, Integrated Applications.
verifyHints.403: Tiki refused the call: the store is inactive or the app lacks the permission.
verifyHints.404: Tiki found no order or product with that id.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Tiki allows 200 requests per second per seller. Wait a moment and try again.

prerequisites: A Tiki seller account (store id) and a Tiki account for the Open Platform console, where you create an in-house application and then approve it in Seller Center. About 10 minutes.

tools.name: tiki_get_seller
tools.description: The seller behind the token: id, name, active, logo, operation_models (dropship, instock, backorder, seller_backorder, cross_border), can_update_product, registration_status and live_at. Read-only.

tools.name: tiki_list_seller_warehouses
tools.description: Seller warehouses (pickup and return addresses): id, name, is_primary, status, type, street, ward, district, region, country and contact, with `paging`. The ids are used for stock per warehouse. Read-only.

tools.name: tiki_list_orders
tools.description: List orders, newest first: code, fulfillment_type, status, is_rma, created_at, updated_at, invoice (subtotal, grand_total, total_seller_income), items (product id, sku, name, seller_product_code, price, quantity, seller income, fees, confirmation status and SLA), shipping, payment and customer, with `paging` (total, current_page, last_page). Read-only.

status.description: Order statuses as a set: `in|` or `nin|` followed by comma-separated statuses, e.g. `nin|processing,waiting_payment` (recommended to skip unpaid orders) or `in|queueing,picking`. Statuses: queueing, processing, waiting_payment, picking, packaging, finished_packing, ready_to_ship, shipping, handover_to_partner, successful_delivery, delivered, complete, closed, canceled, returned, holded, paid, payment_review.

item_confirmation_status.description: Item confirmation: waiting (to confirm), seller_confirmed, seller_canceled, confirmed, ready_to_pick.

fulfillment_type.description: Fulfillment types as a set, e.g. `in|dropship,seller_delivery`. Types: tiki_delivery, seller_delivery, cross_border, dropship, instant_delivery.

filter_date_by.description: Quick range: today, last7days or last30days.

created_from_date.description: Created on or after: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, Vietnam time (UTC+7), e.g. 2026-11-01 00:00:00.

created_to_date.description: Created on or before: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, Vietnam time (UTC+7), e.g. 2026-11-01 00:00:00.

include.description: Extra data, comma-separated: status_histories, item.fees, item.confirmation_histories.

tools.name: tiki_get_order
tools.description: Read one order: code, relation_code, fulfillment_type, status, invoice, Tiki warehouse, items with product, price, quantity, seller income, fees and confirmation (status, available_confirm_sla, pickup_confirm_sla), shipping (address, partner, tracking code), payment, customer, cancel_info, rma_info, seller warehouse and status histories. A code that does not exist answers 400. Read-only.

code.description: Tiki order code, e.g. 105386919 (code of tiki_list_orders).

include.description: Extra data, comma-separated: status_histories, item.fees, item.confirmation_histories.

tools.name: tiki_list_seller_inventories
tools.description: Seller inventories (stock locations) you can confirm orders from, with the Tiki warehouses they serve: seller_inventories and mappings (tiki_warehouse_code to seller_inventory_ids). Needed for tiki_confirm_available and tiki_confirm_dropship. Read-only.

tiki_warehouse_codes.description: Tiki warehouse codes, comma-separated, e.g. sgn,hn4 (tiki_warehouse.code of the order).

tools.name: tiki_get_shipping_label
tools.description: Link to the printable label of an order (HTML): shipping_label_url (tiki-delivery), shipping_label_url and shipping_stamp_url (dropship), invoice_label_url (seller-delivery) or crossborder_label_url (cross-border). Pick the delivery model of the order. Read-only.

code.description: Tiki order code, e.g. 105386919 (code of tiki_list_orders).

delivery_model.description: Delivery model of the order: tiki-delivery, dropship, seller-delivery or cross-border.

tools.name: tiki_list_products
tools.description: List products, newest first: product_id, sku, original_sku (your SKU), name, price, market_price, entity_type, master_id, super_id, categories, images and, with include inventory, inventory (inventory_type, fulfillment_type, warehouse_stocks with quantity_available and quantity_sellable), with `paging`. Read-only.

include.description: inventory: add the stock per warehouse.

created_from_date.description: Created on or after: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, Vietnam time (UTC+7), e.g. 2026-11-01 00:00:00.

created_to_date.description: Created on or before: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, Vietnam time (UTC+7), e.g. 2026-11-01 00:00:00.

updated_from_date.description: Updated on or after: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, Vietnam time (UTC+7), e.g. 2026-11-01 00:00:00.

updated_to_date.description: Updated on or before: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, Vietnam time (UTC+7), e.g. 2026-11-01 00:00:00.

tools.name: tiki_get_product
tools.description: Read one product: name, sku, original_sku, price, market_price, status, attributes, images, categories and stock per warehouse. Read-only.

product_id.description: Tiki product id, e.g. 2088336 (product_id of tiki_list_products).

includes.description: Extra data, comma-separated: seller, categories, inventory, attributes, images.

tools.name: tiki_find_product_by_sku
tools.description: Find a product by your own SKU (original_sku): product_id, sku, name, price, market_price, categories and images. Read-only.

original_sku.description: Your SKU as sent when the product was created.

tools.name: tiki_list_categories
tools.description: Tiki categories: id, name, parent, is_primary and whether products can be created in it. Filter by parent to walk the tree. Read-only.

name.description: Category name or part of it.

is_primary.description: true: only primary categories (where products are created).

tools.name: tiki_get_category_attributes
tools.description: Attributes of one category for product requests: code, display name, data type, is_required and allowed values. Read-only.

tools.name: tiki_list_brands
tools.description: Search Tiki brands by name: id and name, as used in product requests. Read-only.

name.description: Brand name or part of it.

tools.name: tiki_list_tiki_warehouses
tools.description: Tiki warehouses (fulfilment centres): id, code and name, as they appear in orders and seller inventory mappings. Read-only.

tools.name: tiki_list_product_requests
tools.description: Product creation and update requests: id, track_id, state (drafted, processing, waiting, approved, rejected, deleted), reason and the products, with `paging`. Read-only.

include.description: products: add the products of each request.

tools.name: tiki_get_tracking
tools.description: State of an asynchronous product request by its track id: state, reason and the request id once accepted. Read-only.

track_id.description: track_id returned when a product request was submitted.

tools.name: tiki_confirm_available
tools.description: Confirm stock for an order fulfilled from your inventory (tiki_delivery, seller_delivery or cross_border): list the item ids you can supply and the seller inventory they ship from. Items you leave out are cancelled by the seller (seller_canceled), so always list every item you can deliver.

code.description: Tiki order code, e.g. 105386919 (code of tiki_list_orders).

available_item_ids.description: Ids of the order items you can supply (items[].id of tiki_get_order).

tools.name: tiki_confirm_dropship
tools.description: Confirm a dropship order (seller_confirmed) from one seller inventory; Tiki then arranges the pickup.

code.description: Tiki order code, e.g. 105386919 (code of tiki_list_orders).

tools.name: tiki_update_seller_delivery
tools.description: Report the delivery result of an order you deliver yourself (seller_delivery): successful_delivery, or failed_delivery with the cause and, for a new appointment, its date.

code.description: Tiki order code, e.g. 105386919 (code of tiki_list_orders).

failure_cause.description: For failed_delivery: out_of_needs (customer no longer wants it), redelivery_appointment or out_of_stock.

appointment_date.description: New delivery date for redelivery_appointment: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, Vietnam time (UTC+7), e.g. 2026-11-01 00:00:00.

tools.name: tiki_update_product
tools.description: Change the price and the stock per seller warehouse of one product, identified by your original_sku or the Tiki product_id. Stock cannot be changed for products stored at Tiki (instock). Answers state approved, or errors such as a price too far below the listing price.

original_sku.description: Your SKU; give this or product_id.

product_id.description: Tiki product id; give this or original_sku.

warehouse_quantities.description: Stock per seller warehouse: warehouse_id from tiki_list_seller_warehouses and qty_available.

tools.name: tiki_set_product_active
tools.description: Switch one product on (1) or off (0) for sale. 0 takes it off sale on Tiki.

original_sku.description: Your SKU; give this or product_id.

product_id.description: Tiki product id; give this or original_sku.

tools.name: tiki_cancel_dropship
tools.description: Refuse a dropship order (seller_canceled). Cannot be undone; the customer is refunded and it counts against the shop.

code.description: Tiki order code, e.g. 105386919 (code of tiki_list_orders).
